bayts.text: He has opened an opening (a victory) such as was never seen and never will be seen,
for him who made my life good pleasure, He Who perpetuates my glad tidings.
The best of those who give lodging (Qurʾān 23:29) has led to me, through the best of the Messengers
and through the most perfect Companions, the service of the best of mankind.
My religion is the love of Allah together with the love of him who subdued the enemies
for me; and for me He has gathered the wishes, without harm or turbidity.
He has driven toward others than me error and what leads to infirmity
He Who, toward the Gardens, with the lawful, has led me by the Decree.
He has made clear my permanence, my being servant of the One Who makes abide, my help,
through him by whom He perpetuated my guarding from what troubles.
The Everlasting, Who teaches the hidden things, has repelled misery and faults
toward others than my person; and (my) intimates (lit. pockets) were guarded from turbidity.
My Lord has demolished the edifice of my harm: and how excellent is our Lord!
And from Himself He has increased our nearness, a nearness of good pleasure and generosity.
I ask Him for gratitude toward Him, and He has led to me His remembrance,
and toward others than me He has driven His stratagem, and guarded my sanctuary.
To Allah my praise with gratitude: truly He is the Guide (Al-Hādī), the Appreciative (Ash-Shakūr),
and has guarded me from reproof and from what draws punishments upon me.
To Him I have devoted my life, and He is the One Who grants me long life,
without a harm that prevails, nor causes of sickness.
Toward others than me He has repelled every harm, and it was repelled;
and through me He shows whoever has read the best of the middle of the road.
He has guided — He Who made my life good pleasure and granted the choice (of good) —
him whose heart was bewildered in Allah, He Who perpetuates my glad tidings.
